title: How to Find Jobs Faster with Teal's Job Search (Saved Searches + Alerts)
description:
-----------------------------------------------------
Tired of scrolling job boards and still missing the good ones? Teal's Job Search puts millions of listings in one place and surfaces the newest roles first — so you can be among the first to apply. Save any search, set an alert, and let fresh jobs that match come straight to your inbox.

Search by title or company, filter down to exactly what you want, and check your fit on every listing before you apply — all without leaving Teal.

 Sign up for your free Teal account & get your resume job-ready: https://tealhq.co/3VYY8LN

 Find Job Search in your Teal navigation
 Search millions of listings by title or company and spot the newest jobs first
 Save a job, create a tailored resume, or apply — right from a listing
 Save a search and turn on email alerts (instant/hourly alerts are Teal+)
 Narrow results with advanced filters like workplace type and salary
 Read a job's requirements, responsibilities, and keywords to gauge fit fast

transcript: [music] >> Teal's job search gives you access to millions of listings in one place. Find it by hovering over the left navigation bar and clicking job search. >> [music] >> Search by job title or company. The most recently posted jobs surface at the top flagged as new. From any listing, you can save the job directly to your job tracker or create a resume from it to match against the job and identify missing keywords. You can also click to apply, which takes you straight to the application. >> [music] >> If you want to save a search and get notified as new jobs come in, say project manager roles in Chicago, click save search. Name the search, then choose your alert frequency. Email alerts are on by default. >> [music] >> Standard users get daily alerts. Teal Plus users can select instant, which sends updates every hour as new jobs are posted. Once saved, alerts will arrive by email. You can adjust the frequency or update the search at any time from the search itself or from the saved search menu. The notification settings are on the right-hand side. Advanced filters let you narrow results further by workplace type, salary information, and more. So, you're only seeing jobs that match your needs. As you browse, each listing surfaces the job requirements, responsibilities, and relevant keywords on the right-hand side, giving you a quick read on fit before you decide to save or apply. >> [music] >> Teal's job search keeps you connected to new opportunities and gives you everything you need to find your next role. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
